title: alpha-AOS project pack catalog
description: Closed-world contract for a catalog/packs/*.yaml file. The declarations are the single authority for which capability packs a repository qualifies for; code loads and evaluates them but never restates them. Namespaced x-* extensions are split out before validation, so every object described here is exhaustive.

factId.description: A fact declared by the evidence vocabulary, referenced by a predicate leaf.

literalList.description: Inline literals a detector matches directly. The evaluator synthesizes the explaining fact id from the operator and the matched literal.

evidence.description: One predicate node. Exactly the five operators the declared packs use today; the evaluator computes every leaf rather than short-circuiting, so a partial match stays explainable.

all.description: Every named fact must be detected.

any.description: At least one named fact must be detected.

anyFiles.description: At least one of these paths, relative to the canonical root, must exist.

anyDependencies.description: At least one of these package names must be declared by a manifest at the canonical root.

manifestOptIn.description: The named project-manifest key must opt this pack in.

id.description: Stable pack identifier, referenced by receipts and approved plans.

skills.description: ECC skill ids this pack supplies. An empty array declares a pack that supplies no skill.

lifecycle.description: Declared and carried by this phase; materialization acts on it in a later phase.

selectionPolicy.description: How this pack composes with a native engine covering the same ground.
